description: This file defines a BroadcastReceiver, 'BootReceiver', that listens for the system boot completion event and schedules notifications for all tasks stored in the application's TodoDatabase upon device boot.

classes.name: BootReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver that triggers on system boot to reschedule task notifications.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles the broadcast when the device finishes booting; retrieves all tasks from the database and schedules notifications for each.
